name: visualizations: the answer comes from the server, not from memory
description: Written against an observed failure on 2026-09-19: asked which visualization plugins were installed, the agent searched the tool panel, found nothing, and answered that no charting plugins existed, then invented an explanation for why they would be available anyway. The instance had 50. The agent had no tool that could see them, so searching tools was the only move it had. This asserts the two halves of the fix: that it asks Galaxy which visualizations can render the dataset, and that what it says back names one Galaxy actually returned. The installed set differs between servers and changes over time, which is exactly why this may never be answered from the model's own weights. The history is named with the run token rather than called "this history": the harness binds a history but does not put its id in the prompt, and earlier runs leave their own copies of the fixture behind, so a positional reference would be testing whether the agent guesses the right history among many. That is a real question, and a different one.
inputs: In my history "visualization discovery $run", which visualizations can Galaxy display the dataset with?
